content: Official Sovereign Engineering materials center open permissionless self-sovereign systems, escape from attention-economy models, shipping usable tools, high-bandwidth dialogue, weekly show-talk-build rhythms, rotating leadership, Madeira and maritime ship/shipyard imagery, and alumni friendship. Brand recommendation: endorsed subbrand territory is strongest, using a living-place/maritime name and explicit by Sovereign Engineering endorsement; direct-extension territory maximizes trust but feels institutional; independent names gain portability but lose immediate alumni recognition. Avoid static ancient-agora cliches and elite hacker-exclusion framing.
